import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
addr = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress("140593b70")
f = currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("function absent")
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(currentProgram)
    result = d.decompileFunction(f, 300, monitor)
    if not result.decompileCompleted():
        raise RuntimeError(str(result.getErrorMessage()))
    print(json.dumps({"sha256": str(currentProgram.getExecutableSHA256()),
                      "address": str(addr), "signature": str(f.getSignature()),
                      "decompiled_code": result.getDecompiledFunction().getC()}))
finally:
    d.dispose()
